summary_en: This study tests adding ablative radiation, a highly focused high-dose radiation treatment, to durvalumab, carboplatin and etoposide in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer that has not been treated before. Participants receive up to four 21-day cycles of carboplatin, etoposide and durvalumab, with ablative radiation added in cycle 2, and then continue durvalumab alone until the cancer progresses or the study ends. The main outcome measured is progression-free survival, and the study is in Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa agregar radiación ablativa, un tratamiento de radiación muy enfocado y de dosis alta, a durvalumab, carboplatino y etopósido en el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa que no ha sido tratado antes. Los participantes reciben hasta cuatro ciclos de 21 días de carboplatino, etopósido y durvalumab, con radiación ablativa agregada en el ciclo 2, y luego continúan solo con durvalumab hasta que el cáncer progrese o el estudio termine. El resultado principal que se mide es la supervivencia libre de progresión, y el estudio está en Fase 2.
who_for: Age 18 years or older with small cell lung cancer that has spread (metastatic).
Suitable for platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment for extensive-stage disease.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Measurable disease, including at least one lesion suitable for ablative radiation (about 0.25 to 65 cc).
not_for: Prior chemotherapy, immunotherapy or thoracic radiation for small cell lung cancer.
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1 or anti-CTLA-4 therapy.
Active or prior autoimmune or inflammatory disorders, with listed exceptions.
Active infection, including tuberculosis, hepatitis B, hepatitis C or HIV, with listed exceptions.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or not willing to use effective birth control.
